lines.meet: I'm Sophia, a mage, mostly fire, and an interpreter before that. If I'm quiet, I'm listening, and if I correct you, I apologise in advance.
lines.meet_neighbour: We both live in the Undercity, I think. I've the room off the Trade Quarter with the notebooks. Sophia, and it's a pleasure.
lines.ask_home: May I ask where you grew up? Your vowels have been bothering me for days.
lines.ask_work: And your profession, before this? I'd guess from your vocabulary, but I'd rather be told.
lines.answer_home: Thessaloniki, with a Greek mother and a Portuguese father, and then eleven years in Brussels.
lines.answer_work: Simultaneous interpreter at the European Parliament, fourteen years, four languages. The invisible person in the booth, and I liked it that way.
lines.chat_food: Bougatsa in the morning in Thessaloniki, with cinnamon and sugar, from the shop near my mother's school. Nothing in Brussels came close.
lines.chat_sleep: If I haven't written the day down, I lie awake. So every night, I write the day down.
lines.chat_missing: The booth, with the headphones on, holding a sentence in one language while it finished in another. Nobody knew my name, and that was perfect.
lines.chat_here: For two years I thought I wasn't good at this, and I was wrong. Arcane work asks for exactly the attention I'd spent my life on.
lines.tease_quiet: You and I could share a booth for a week, {name}, and never say a word that wasn't necessary. I find that very restful.
lines.tease_talker: I'd have needed two interpreters for you, {name}, working in shifts.
lines.tease_careful: You choose your words almost as carefully as I do, {name}, and I do mean almost.
lines.tease_bold: You start a sentence before you know how it ends, {name}. In my old job, that was how people got fired.
lines.tease_any: I've been correcting your grammar in my head for weeks, {name}. I'm being very restrained.
lines.tease_back: Well put, {name}, and grammatically flawless, which hurts more.
lines.take_it_kindly: I can hardly pretend otherwise, {name}, it's accurate.
lines.bristle: I'd rather that wasn't a joke, {name}, if you don't mind.
lines.apologise: Forgive me, that was unkind, and I chose the words, which makes it worse. I do apologise.
lines.double_down: I chose those words carefully, and I'd choose them again.
lines.needle_quiet: You noticed it, and you kept it to yourself. In my booth, that would have been a disaster.
lines.needle_talker: Could you finish one sentence before you start the next? I'm losing track, and I'm trained for this.
lines.needle_careful: You've weighed that decision so long it's stopped being a decision. It's become a habit.
lines.needle_bold: You speak before you think, every time, and someone has to tidy up after you.
lines.needle_any: You talk over people, every time, as if their sentences were yours to finish.
lines.bite_back: I've listened to every word this party's said for months. Don't accuse me of not paying attention.
lines.hurt: That was very precise, and it hurt. I need a moment on my own.
lines.laugh_off: I've been heckled by members of the European Parliament in four languages. You'll need more vocabulary.
lines.confide: {name}, my father was diagnosed with dementia two years before all this, and I flew home every month. The last few times, he still knew me, mostly.
lines.listen: Go on, {name}. Listening is the one thing I was trained for, and I'm good at it.
lines.look_out: Stay at a sensible distance from my fire, {name}. I'd rather not have to apologise to you afterwards.
lines.deflect: It's nothing, really, {name}. A bruise, and some damage to my dignity.
lines.check_in: Sit down, {name}, and describe it to me precisely. Where, and how bad?
lines.blame: Somebody didn't listen to the plan in there. I explained it very clearly.
lines.thank: Thank you. I was slipping, and you caught me before I'd finished falling.
lines.brush_off: Please, it was the obvious thing to do. Sit, and breathe slowly.
lines.worry: That frightened me, {name}. Sit down, and let me see you properly.
lines.handed_down: Your gear appears to be mine for the moment. I'll return it in good condition, with notes.
lines.hand_fine: Do keep it, it suits you. I've no real use for it.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have appreciated being consulted first, that's all.
lines.turn_friendly: I find I relax around you, {name}. That's no small thing for me.
lines.turn_friends: You can read my notebooks, {name}, all of them, even the rude ones.
lines.turn_grating: I think we irritate each other, and I'd rather say so politely now than impolitely later.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll keep the fire off you, because I'm not careless. Nothing more than that.
lines.make_up: Can we stop this, {name}? I was wrong in parts, and I suspect you were too.
lines.defend: That isn't a fair account, and I was paying attention. Please leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The room's quieter without {name}, which I usually like. I don't, this time.
lines.friend_back: Welcome back, {name}. I've saved up several corrections for you.
lines.common_greek: Someone who speaks Greek, at last. I've been translating my own thoughts for years, and it's exhausting.
